proposed_reports.title: 2026 Property Tax and Supplementary Property Tax Bylaw (Bylaw 21442)
proposed_reports.description: Annual bylaw under section 353 of the Municipal Government Act authorizing municipal, education and Designated Industrial Property requisition tax rates against the assessment roll and provincial assessment roll for the taxation year. Passed 28 April 2026; sets residential municipal rate at 0.0077419 and non-residential at 0.0252216 among other classes.

proposed_reports.title: City of Edmonton Approved Operating Budget (multi-year cycle with annual tax-levy confirmation)
proposed_reports.description: Detailed tax-supported and utility operating budget for the current year within the 2023-2026 multi-year framework, finalized via spring tax-levy confirmation. 2026 version incorporates a 6.9% municipal tax increase and funds core services, debt servicing and transfers.

proposed_reports.title: City of Edmonton Annual Report — Consolidated Audited Financial Statements
proposed_reports.description: Annual consolidated audited financial statements (Statement of Financial Position, Operations, Cash Flows and notes) prepared under Canadian public sector accounting standards for the year ended 31 December, including tax-supported operations, utilities, EPCOR equity accounting and education tax remittances. 2025 edition released spring 2026.

proposed_reports.title: Property Assessment Notices / Assessment Roll
proposed_reports.description: Annual market-value assessment notices mailed to property owners (January) under the Municipal Government Act, forming the assessment roll against which tax rates are levied. Values reflect the prior-year July 1 market condition; open data extract of assessed values also published.

proposed_reports.title: Saskatchewan Budget — Fiscal Plan / Summary Financial Statements Outlook
proposed_reports.description: Annual provincial budget documents (Budget Address, Estimates, Highlights, Fiscal Outlook) setting revenue, expense and deficit projections for the fiscal year beginning 1 April. 2026-27 edition projects $21.4 billion revenue, $22.2 billion expense and an $819 million deficit, with multi-year outlook to surplus in 2030-31.

proposed_reports.title: Saskatchewan Assessment Management Agency (SAMA) — Assessment Governance, Valuation Services and Roll Confirmation
proposed_reports.description: Provincial agency responsible for property assessment policy, valuation services to ~760 municipalities, quality assurance audits, and statutory confirmation of municipal assessment rolls. Publishes annual report, revaluation manuals (four-year cycle), business plan and confirmed assessment totals; assessment base ~$278 billion supporting ~$2.6 billion in property taxes.

proposed_reports.title: SAMA Annual Report
proposed_reports.description: Annual report of SAMA operations, financial results, property review volumes, confirmed assessment totals by class and municipal type, and quality-assurance audit outcomes for the preceding calendar year.

proposed_reports.title: Manitoba Budget — Summary Budget and Financial Updates
proposed_reports.description: Annual Summary Budget prepared under GAAP presenting consolidated revenue, expense, operating surplus/deficit and net debt for the fiscal year ending 31 March. 2026/27 edition projects $26.8 billion revenue, $27.3 billion expense and a $498 million deficit, with medium-term path to small surpluses.

proposed_reports.title: Manitoba Property Assessment Services (Municipal and Northern Relations)
proposed_reports.publisher: Manitoba Municipal and Northern Relations — Property Assessment Services
proposed_reports.description: Provincial assessment authority responsible for market-value assessment of all real and personal property outside the City of Winnipeg (approximately 440 000 roll entries). Conducts regular reassessments, maintains Manitoba Assessment Online, and recovers costs via the statutory Property Assessment Levy on municipalities. Winnipeg maintains its own assessment function.
proposed_reports.publication_cadence: continuous (reassessment cycle typically biennial or as legislated)
